name: Bold Signal
tagline: Charcoal gradient stage with a tilted vermilion card, huge uppercase section numerals and orange-ruled panels.

palette.description: Near-black charcoal with warm off-white text and one vermilion accent.

typography.style: Heavy grotesque display over a neutral geometric sans.

best_for: High-impact decks that need one loud colour block on a dark stage. Works for launches and keynotes with short, punchy copy.
avoid_for: Long dense reports where huge uppercase numerals would crowd the text.
